description: Multi-column brochure page 3 (scanned): the hand-drawn plot map is a figure, not the whole page, and the street name under it stays text.

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: Without an OCR runner, the page is not rasterized by OCR, so the page scan sees another page.
assertions.why: The map itself covers 0.66 of the page (hand box [96,80,592,724]), above the issue's 0.6; 0.7 still rejects the whole page.

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: Without an OCR runner, the scanned page converts with no text.
assertions.why: The street under the map, read on the page image.
The map's labels are OCR junk, not headings.
